data.title: 摩根 · 夏之水妃
data.description: 【摩根 · 夏之水妃】盛夏的海滩上，换上水妃泳装的摩根难得露出浅淡的笑意，银发被海风扬起，白纱裙摆在水边轻轻荡漾——「这个夏天……偶尔也容许本王任性一次。」
data.action: 穿白色挂颈泳装和轻薄白色罩裙沿浅浪水边漫步，侧头微笑
data.camera: full-body side view, walking at the waterline
data.promptProse: Morgan walks along the summer waterline in her white halter swimsuit and light white beach wrap, turning her head with a restrained smile. Loose silver hair moves beside the wrap as each step leaves a brief print in wet sand. The full-body side view includes the next wave approaching her feet and the receding shore. Beach sun brightens the moving fabric, with clear reflected water light beneath and a soft sand shadow behind.
